# Registration

If you are using the [Fluence Console](https://console.fluence.network/) for the first time, register using one of the following methods:
1. Email (passwordless sign-in)
2. Google account
3. GitHub account

After successful registration, you have access to the Fluence Console. The Public cloud (CPU virtual machines) is available on request; see [Fluence Console UI Access](./overview.md#fluence-console-ui-access).

Your account balance is in USD; see [Payment and balance management](./balance.md) to top it up.

:::tip
AI agents and scripts don't need to register: [paying with x402](./api/x402.md) creates an account bound to the paying wallet.
:::
